papers.title: Canonical ampleness of compact hyperbolic Kähler manifolds
papers.subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
papers.summary: Every compact connected Kähler manifold of positive complex dimension with no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle and is therefore projective. This proves Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in the smooth compact Kähler setting.

papers.title: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six
papers.result_title: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six
papers.subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
papers.summary: Proves the Campana–Peternell conjecture in complex dimension six: every smooth connected complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous.

papers.title: A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture
papers.result_title: A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture
papers.subject: Differential geometry
papers.summary: Disproves the unrestricted nearby Lagrangian conjecture. For some sufficiently large even N, constructs a closed exact embedded Lagrangian in T^*(S^9\times S^{N-1}) that is diffeomorphic to the base but not Hamiltonian isotopic to its zero section.

papers.title: The p-adic section conjecture
papers.result_title: The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences
papers.subject: Number theory
papers.summary: Proves that rational points on every smooth proper geometrically connected curve of genus at least two over a finite extension of ℚp correspond bijectively to conjugacy classes of sections of its full arithmetic étale fundamental group. It also proves Grothendieck's section conjecture over ℚ for the modular curves X_0(N) and X_1(N) of genus at least two.

papers.title: Interior regularity of planar Mumford–Shah minimizers
papers.result_title: The planar Mumford–Shah regularity conjecture and local weak-L4 gradient bounds
papers.subject: Partial differential equations
papers.summary: Resolves the interior regularity conjecture for reduced absolute planar Mumford–Shah minimizers with bounded fidelity data. Locally, the closed discontinuity set is a C^{1,\alpha} arc, a regular crack tip, or three arcs meeting at 120^\circ; only finitely many global connected components meet any compact interior region.
